content: 1. Administer 0.1 mg/kg of the drug via infusion over 5 minutes or as a direct injection over 30 seconds, 30 minutes prior to chemotherapy. 2. For transdermal patch application, apply one patch 24–48 hours before chemotherapy. The patch should remain in place for at least 24 hours post-chemotherapy and can be worn for up to 7 days. 3. For extended-release subcutaneous (SC) administration, inject 10 mg SC in combination with dexamethasone at least 30 minutes before initiating moderately emetogenic chemotherapy (MEC) or anthracycline-cyclophosphamide (AC) combination chemotherapy. 4. For oral (PO) administration, give 2 mg one hour before radiation therapy. 5. For prevention of nausea and vomiting, administer 1 mg undiluted intravenously (IV) as a push over 30 seconds, either before anesthetic induction or immediately before anesthesia reversal. 6. For treatment purposes, administer 1 mg undiluted IV as a push over 30 seconds. 7. For patients with moderate renal impairment (CrCl 30–59 mL/min), administer the subcutaneous formulation (Sustol) on Day 1 of chemotherapy, ensuring a minimum interval of 14 days between doses. 8. Avoid the use of the subcutaneous formulation (Sustol) in patients with severe renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min). 9. For IV administration in patients with severe renal failure, total drug clearance is not significantly affected when a single 40 mcg/kg IV dose is given. 10. No dosage adjustment is required for oral administration in patients with renal impairment.
